prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted impact, while zero or negative forecasts sometimes preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-15.8% and -9.0%).
Adding new flows during adoption (adoption, new_flow) consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 3 tests (-13.3%, -4.5%, and -1.0%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both agreeing tests (+0.9% and +1.9%).
Waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) mostly showed no clear effect across 8 of 11 tests, despite 2 winning tests (+3.6% and +6.5%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) produced inconsistent results, ranging from strong wins to severe losses.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Split View Layout: Redesign the Choose Path screen using a side-by-side split layout comparing pet onboarding styles. (why: Choose path has a high mean duration of 514s, suggesting users hesitate when choosing a path.)
1: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Checklist Layout Redesign: Rebuild the Sign In screen using a structured checklist layout that outlines account security and pet sync benefits. (why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or resetting after signing back in, and sign-in drop-off is 11.9%.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Checklist Layout: Redesign the Pick Friend screen into an interactive checklist layout summarizing pet traits. (why: Adoption stage experiences a 21.2% drop-off rate with an average time spent of 1017 seconds.)
3: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Card Layout Redesign: Redesign the final onboarding screen using a card layout to visually highlight desktop companion controls. (why: The finish step has a high drop-off rate of 24.5%, and support reported post-onboarding confusion regarding pet controls.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Persistent Session Headline Update: Update the Sign In screen headline and body copy to explain that signing in permanently links your pet to your account across sessions. (why: Support received 8 emails from users whose pets were reset or missing after re-authenticating.)
5: [finish, layout] Home Intro Two Column Layout: Update the home intro screen layout to a two-column design that pairs desktop placement details with control instructions. (why: 24.5% of users abandon at the finish step, and users frequently write to support asking how to hide or control their desktop pet.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Selection Guidance Hint: Add an inline hint explaining that path choices can be customized at any time post-setup. (why: Users take an average of 514s on the choose_path step, indicating indecision during selection.)
7: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Readiness Badge: Add a visual environment readiness badge component to the waiting screen. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting that pets failed to launch onto the desktop or the app stalled before opening.)
8: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Story Scroll Layout: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a story scroll layout displaying pet details sequentially. (why: Adoption experiences the highest drop-off rate prior to completion (21.2%).)
9: [adoption, hint] Upload Photos Image Lighting Hint: Add an inline hint on photo upload urging users to submit clear, well-lit photos for pet generation. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or rendering incorrectly.)
